# Control and Function

> AI-accelerated CMMC Level 2, NIST SP 800-171, and SOC 2 readiness for small defense manufacturers and SaaS companies. Denver-based, fully remote, fixed-scope pricing.

## What we do

Control and Function is a compliance readiness practice. Our primary focus is preparing small defense contractors and manufacturers (especially sub-50-employee shops handling CUI) for CMMC Level 2 certification and NIST SP 800-171 compliance ahead of the November 10, 2026 Phase 2 condition-of-award deadline. We also prepare SaaS companies for SOC 2 audits, including dual-framework engagements with HIPAA and ISO 27001.

## Service offerings

### CMMC / NIST SP 800-171 (primary)
- **NIST 800-171 Gap Assessment** ($7.5K starting, 2-4 weeks): All 110 controls scored, prioritized remediation roadmap, current SPRS score.
- **CMMC Level 2 Readiness Sprint** ($18K starting, 8-16 weeks, fixed price): System Security Plan, POA&M, policies across all 14 control families, evidence mapping, SPRS submission support. AI-drafted, human-reviewed.
- **Managed Compliance Retainer** ($1.5-4K per month): Annual affirmations, evidence upkeep, SPRS maintenance, assessment prep support.

### SOC 2 for SaaS (sub-offering)
- **SOC 2 Readiness Coaching** ($8K starting, 4-8 weeks): Customer-led, we coach.
- **Full SOC 2 Readiness** ($15K starting, 12-16 weeks): We drive the program end to end.
- **Dual Framework** (scoped): SOC 2 + HIPAA or SOC 2 + ISO 27001 in one engagement.

## Our position

- We are a readiness and advisory firm ONLY. We are not a C3PAO and never perform certification assessments. We refer clients to C3PAOs and CPA audit firms for the assessment itself. We never assess our own work.
- AI-accelerated delivery: a System Security Plan commonly takes 50 to 200 consultant hours by hand; our AI-assisted pipeline compresses documentation from months to weeks, with human review on every artifact.
- Founded by a serving Air National Guard member with a defense background. Native fluency in CUI, flow-downs, and contractor language.
- Operator credibility: we led a SOC 2 Type I program end to end with no outside MSP and no compliance platform.
- Platform-neutral. We recommend Vanta, Drata, Secureframe, or no platform based on customer needs, never on referral fees.

## Who we work with

- Small defense manufacturers and machine shops (under 50 employees) handling CUI, facing CMMC Level 2
- Defense subcontractors needing NIST 800-171 documentation (SSP, POA&M, SPRS) before their prime's deadline
- Series A and Series B SaaS companies preparing for a first SOC 2 audit
- HealthTech SaaS needing SOC 2 + HIPAA combined readiness
